title: Unit 5 Consolidation: Roots, Tradition & Collective Memory

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can accurately form and interpret frequentative (-gat/-get) and contemplative (-dogál/-degél/-dögél) verbs
I can distinguish instantaneous (-an/-en, -ant/-int) from iterative verbal stems in narrative contexts
I can use reduplicated generational idioms (nemzedékről nemzedékre, szájról szájra) and Unit 5's cultural vocabulary
